results.content:
Morning Consult rolls up its poll results over a three-month period to calculate the state approval rating. Surveys conducted April 1-June 30 found 41% of registered voters in North Carolina approve of Trump's job performance, compared to 56% who disapprove.

The Economist uses weekly YouGov polls to make projections of the state-level approval ratings. In North Carolina, Trump is also in the red by a margin of 23 percentage points, according to The Economist.
